15:16.text: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

15:17.text: And We have protected it from every devil expelled

15:18.text: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

15:19.text: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein

15:20.text: And We have made for you therein means of living and
those for whom you are not providers.

15:21.text: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known

15:22.text: And We have sent the fertilizing winds
and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.

15:23.text: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.

15:24.text: And We have already known the preceding
among you, and We have already known the later

15:25.text: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

15:26.text: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.

15:27.text: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

15:28.text: , when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

15:30.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
